segments.name: Luxury resale
segments.description: Runs an online marketplace and retail stores selling authenticated, primarily pre-owned luxury goods to buyers, with consignment services for consignors.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reportable segment as its CODM reviews financial information on a consolidated basis.

revenueModel.text: Buyers pay for pre-owned luxury goods, while consignors pay the company a percentage of sale proceeds as a take rate.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company retains a percentage of the proceeds received as payment for its consignment service, which the Company refers to as its take rate.
